name: Fuse & Bulb Replacement
summary: Glove-box fuse box location and general fuse rules are corroborated. Trunk and engine-bay fuse locations, fuse puller location, a verified fuse chart, and halogen bulb access procedure are missing. Bulb type is variant-dependent: xenon cars use D1S (3 sources); halogen LCI 328xi reported H7 (single thread). Fog bulb type is in conflict. Xenon bulb steps came from a single retailer how-to. Publish fuse section (glove box only, with owner-chart caveat) and a bulb section gated on headlight type.
variantDependencies: Headlights: xenon (D1S, adaptive in some cars) vs halogen (reported H7) - must be identified on the car; sources do not give the option code (e.g. S522 xenon) mapping.
Fog lights: H8, H11 or HB4/9006 reported - depends on build/bumper (M-Tech vs standard) and pre-/post-LCI; CONFLICT.
Fuse layouts differ by production year and options; fuseandrelay shows two glove-box layouts; use the diagram on the car's cover.
Tail lamp bulbs differ pre-LCI vs LCI (Turner listings mention LCI from 09/2008); 2010 build date vs LCI split not confirmed from VIN.
Angel-eye bulbs: H8 35W (Turner), ZKW variant for builds up to 09/2008.

steps.title: Identify the failed circuit
steps.instruction: Switch ignition off, identify the circuit and consult the diagram on the glove-box cover or the owner's manual.

steps.title: Open the glove-box fuse panel
steps.instruction: Open the glove box, turn the two round plastic fasteners a quarter turn to drop the cover, photograph the layout.
warnings: Panel is tight to reach; a fuse puller helps.

steps.title: Swap the fuse
steps.instruction: Pull the suspect fuse, compare with the chart, fit a fuse of identical rating.
warnings: Never fit a higher amp rating; a repeat blow means a short.

steps.title: Trunk / engine-bay fuses
warnings: Do not publish locations without evidence.

steps.title: Confirm headlight type
steps.instruction: Determine whether the car has xenon (D1S) or halogen headlights before ordering any bulb.
warnings: Xenon units are high voltage; ballast can stay energized.

steps.title: Xenon low-beam bulb (single retailer procedure)
steps.instruction: Disconnect the battery, remove the front wheel and fender liner screws, remove the bulb cover screws (six T20 per source), press the retaining clips, pull and replace the D1S, plug in, test lights before reassembly, replace both sides together.
warnings: Battery disconnect on E90 triggers registration/reset issues only if the battery is replaced; confirm with owner.

steps.title: Tail/turn/fog bulbs
steps.instruction: No sourced access procedure for E90 sedan.

safety: HID systems carry high voltage; disconnect before touching bulbs or ballast.
Do not handle halogen/xenon glass with bare fingers.
Use jack stands, never just a jack.
